Subject: ops issue near Chilliwack, BC
To compliance inbox,
Just finished my site visit near Chilliwack, BC. At 16:15 on July 11, I found that the Prairie
Midstream Ltd. pipeline was being operated outside its design limits. No leak or release
occurred.
I'm not sure what the equipment or activity was, but it was clear the pipeline was outside
normal ops. I'll need to review the data to understand what happened.
Found this at approx. 16:15 on July 11.
Samantha Lee
Pipeline Patrol Contractor
